signals.message: Rent is 64% below the RTB 2025 average for a 1-bed in Rathmines, Dublin 6 (€1,408).
Landlord claims to be abroad or out of the country and cannot show the property.

Offers to send keys or a contract by post or courier after payment, instead of handing them over at a viewing. Official advice is to check the keys work before paying; scammers may send fake keys or false contracts.
signals.evidence: matched phrase "I will post the keys"

signals.message: Asks for payment by cash, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer services (e.g. Western Union) or peer-to-peer transfer apps.
Contact only through WhatsApp, Messenger, text, email or social media; no phone call or meeting.

advice: Do not pay a deposit before viewing in person. Avoid cash, crypto, money transfer services and foreign accounts. If in doubt, contact Threshold or report to An Garda Síochána.
disclaimer: Automated risk signals, not a verdict. Prototype.
